item.description: In the 2025/2026 season, the UniNa Corse racing team from Federico II University of Naples took on the ambitious challenge of designing, building, and racing a fully electric car - pushing the limits of innovation and engineering.

item.title: Meter/Mix Machine Types for Processing Plural Component Thermosets
item.description: Fluidic Systems metering and mixing machines are widely used in the Aerospace Industry for their accuracy in processing adhesive/sealants and coatings. This white paper compares meter/mix technologies and highlights the advances of Fluidic Systems dispensing technology.

item.title: From Spreadsheets to Insights: Fast Data Analysis Without Complex Programming
item.description: Engineers and technicians working with test data often struggle with spreadsheet limitations: frozen screens on large datasets, manual copying of data between files from different DAQ systems and hitting data size limits. Wrestling with Excel for measurement evaluation is detrimental to efficiency and productivity, but modern software can provide professional capabilities without the programming complexity.

item.title: Mixing Technologies in the Battery Industry
item.description: This white paper explores the critical role of mixing technologies in the rapidly evolving battery industry, where precision and efficiency directly impact product performance and scalability. Proper mixer selection not only influences the electrochemical performance and longevity of batteries but also optimizes production efficiency, reduces material waste, and enhances process scalability.

item.title: Linear Motion Design for Washdown Applications
item.description: Linear motion components must be carefully selected when designing automation equipment for washdown environments, where food safe is required. There are multiple choices for linear motion designs that are best suited for these washdown applications. PBC Linear offers a variety of products and materials such as linear plain bearings, linear guides, stainless steel shafting, and aluminum shafting that all meet these demanding environmental conditions.
